visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens at a snow-covered mountain resort. A young child in a blue jacket and helmet walks toward the slopes. Adults in snowboarding gear stand nearby under a cloudy sky. The lighting is flat and natural. (2) A man in a brown jacket assists a small child on a snowboard on a gentle slope. The camera follows their slow movement. Other skiers are visible in the distant background against white peaks. (3) The perspective shifts to a medium shot of the child trying to balance on the board while an instructor holds their waist. They are near a transparent tunnel structure on the snow. (4) The environment changes to a grey, overcast day with light snow falling. A woman in a mint green jacket sits on the snow with a snowboard. A young child in a red hood is held close, crying with visible tears. (5) Transition to a bright, sunny day. A child in a vibrant, multicolored geometric snowsuit snowboards confidently down a groomed run. The camera pans to track the high-speed motion. (6) Two younger children in star-patterned snowsuits walk toward the camera. Later, one of them attempts to snowboard while an adult provides support. The background shows a modern resort building and pine trees. (7) A woman in a tan snowsuit and yellow goggles snowboards smoothly down a wide slope. The camera captures her from behind as she carves through the snow. (8) A group of people in winter gear stand outside a building labeled 'UENOTAIRA STATION'. A man in a blue and red patterned suit snowboards through a wooded area with birch trees. (9) The child in the multicolored suit performs small jumps and turns on the slope. A woman in a black jacket is shown falling onto the snow while snowboarding. The lighting is bright and clear.
